neighbours.label: upstate New York and Lake Champlain country: the Adirondacks, Onondaga, the Catskills, Lake Champlain, SUNY; mountains and lakes elsewhere (the Smokies, the Rockies, Lake Tahoe) stay low
fire: We canoed for a week in the Adirondacks.
The Onondaga Nation lives south of Syracuse.
Her son studies engineering at SUNY Buffalo.
Ice fishing huts dot Lake Champlain in February.
The trail climbs the highest peak in the Catskills.
Black flies are fierce in the Adirondack spring.
A ferry crosses Lake Champlain to Vermont.
Old hotels in the Catskills once drew city families.

Black flies are fierce in the Rockies in spring.
A ferry crosses Lake Michigan to Wisconsin.
Old hotels in the Poconos once drew city families.
